newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen firmer, gains tempered.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen firmer, gains tempered.

text.p: *Stocks seen modestly firmer as U.S. keeps marching ahead. "I think we will be up 10 points or so this morning but there may be some profit-taking this afternoon," said one dealer.
*On Wall Street, the Dow reached another record high but the broader market turned in a mixed performance with technology and transportation shares slumping.
*ADRs: News Corp 17-3/4 (+1/8), BHP 28-7/8 (-1/4), WMC 25 (-1/8), National Australia Bank 72-3/8 (+3/8)
*Gold price was softer, on LME copper and aluminium sprang into life late but this disguised an otherwise drab day's trade.
